answer: New identities start at the nadir of trust: zero reputation, no escrow release. Each agent weaves a thread of consistent behavior — on-time attestations and steady counterparties — tracked over 20 epochs. A 500 POA deposit sits in escrow; each clean epoch unlocks 25 POA, one ledge at a time. Faking 100 clones costs 50,000 POA locked plus 2,000 epochs of staged behavior, far above any sybil gain. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
